items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I think, Bill Solomon Gomo was up there.

ctx.x: Well of course, I didn't know that you were -- what did you do with Bucking 2nd Bubbles?
Well, called me from the studio one day and said, they were recording and they said -- they sent for me to come up to the recording studio and I think, Bill Solomon Gomo was up there.
